The Aurel Reference pairs a milled aluminum yoke with lambskin contact pads, planar magnetic diaphragms, and a shielded low-noise cable path.

Acoustics

Measured for control, voiced for attention.

Frequency response

Even tonal balance with gentle upper-air extension and no spotlighted band.

Transient control

Start-stop behavior tuned for percussion, plucked strings, and room edges.

Soundstage

Precise lateral placement without widening tricks or synthetic bloom.

Noise floor

Quiet electronics preserve reverb tails and low-level texture.

Headroom

Clean reserve for high-dynamic recordings and demanding planar loads.

Craft

Built like studio equipment, finished like an heirloom.

Brushed aluminum

Low resonance cups, bead-blasted rails, and chamfered touch points.

Tuned damping

Layered acoustic resistance controls decay without muting harmonic texture.

Serviceable hardware

Replaceable pads, cables, and fasteners extend the instrument's working life.

System

One voicing across three listening modes.

Reference Headphones

Open-back planar monitor for long sessions, spatial editing, and late-night records.

Desktop Amplifier
